items.title: Understanding Elastic Load Balancing vs. Amazon S3
items.objective: Clarify the roles and functionalities of Elastic Load Balancing and Amazon S3 in achieving high availability.
items.why_included: Critical gap identified: Confuses the role of Elastic Load Balancing with Amazon S3 in distributing traffic for high availability.

items.title: AWS IAM Fundamentals
items.objective: Understand the purpose of AWS IAM in managing user identities and permissions.
items.why_included: Critical gap identified: Lacks understanding of AWS IAM's role in managing user identities and permissions, confusing it with Amazon VPC.

items.title: Data Protection Strategies in Amazon S3
items.objective: Learn about data protection methods in Amazon S3, including encryption and access settings.
items.why_included: Moderate gap identified: Misunderstands data protection strategies in S3, confusing encryption with public access settings.

items.title: Cost Optimization Strategies in AWS
items.objective: Explore effective cost optimization strategies and debunk myths about provisioning at maximum capacity.
items.why_included: Moderate gap identified: Confuses cost optimization strategies, incorrectly believing that provisioning at maximum capacity minimizes costs.
